intro.title: Modern comprehensive manufacturer of lubricating oils and greases
intro.p1: Cerotd (Shandong) Lubrication Technology Co., Ltd. is a modern, comprehensive and professional manufacturer of lubricating oils and greases, integrating R&D, production, sales, service, technical training and logistics distribution, and boasts a considerable industry scale and influence in the domestic market.
intro.p2: The company is located in Jining City, Shandong Province, known as the Hometown of Confucius and Mencius, the Land of Propriety and Righteousness. Rooted in Jibei Ershilipu New Material Industrial Park, it stands as a vibrant and promising rising star with strong growth momentum in the park. Our factory is equipped with advanced fully automatic blending production lines, and has established a strict and comprehensive quality management system.
intro.p3: We have long been deeply engaged in the R&D and innovation of automotive lubricants. With solid professional technical strength, we deliver high-tech, specialized and comprehensive lubricant production solutions to fully meet the lubrication needs of various types of equipment.

item1.name: Systemized Quality
item1.desc: ISO quality, environmental, and occupational health & safety systems supporting stable delivery.

item2.name: Materials & Formulas
item2.desc: Base oils, additives, and technical formulas introduced from Fortune Global 500 enterprise resources.

item3.name: Continuous R&D
item3.desc: Cooperation with global partners and research institutes to keep upgrading products and technology.

item1.text: The factory covers an area of more than 85 mu (approx. 56,667 square meters), with 10,000 square meters of standardized workshops and a maximum oil storage capacity of 15,000 cubic meters.

item2.text: The company has passed certifications including ISO 9001 Quality Management System, ISO Environmental Management System and OHSAS 18001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System. Base oils, additives and technical formulas are fully introduced from Fortune Global 500 enterprises.

item3.text: Annual production capacity exceeds 100,000 tons. Products cover industrial oils, automotive oils, special oils, construction machinery oils, automotive care products and more.

item4.text: We cooperate extensively with internationally renowned enterprises such as Lubrizol, Infineum and Rhein Chemie, as well as domestic research institutes and universities. A complete range of testing equipment helps ensure product stability.

cf4-15w40.name: CF-4 15W-40
cf4-15w40.summary: Diesel engine oil focused on anti-wear and durability.
cf4-15w40.description: Designed for common diesel engine operating conditions, with attention to oil-film strength, wear protection and stable running. Formal approvals and detailed specs can be provided on request.

cf4-20w50.name: CF-4 20W-50
cf4-20w50.description: For diesel engines that need stronger oil-film support under hot or heavy-duty conditions.

ch4-15w40.name: CH-4 15W-40
ch4-15w40.summary: CH-4 diesel engine oil with stronger heavy-duty protection.
ch4-15w40.description: Suitable for heavy-duty diesel lubrication needs, focusing on detergency/dispersancy and anti-wear durability.

ch4-20w50.name: CH-4 20W-50
ch4-20w50.description: For heavy-duty and high-temperature diesel conditions requiring stronger film and load-carrying protection.

ci4-15w40.name: CI-4 15W-40
ci4-15w40.summary: CI-4 diesel engine oil for higher-performance diesel duty.
ci4-15w40.description: For diesel engines with higher performance requirements, emphasizing cleanliness, anti-wear and thermal stability.

atf6.name: ATF6
atf6.summary: Automatic transmission fluid for smooth shifting and stable friction.
atf6.description: Used for automatic transmission lubrication and friction control. Vehicle fitment and formal specifications can be confirmed on request.

atf9.name: ATF9
atf9.description: For automatic transmission lubrication needs, focusing on shift smoothness and system protection.

atf10.name: ATF10
atf10.description: Automatic transmission lubrication grade. Formal fitment and parameters can be completed later as needed.

antifreeze-g11-green.name: Antifreeze G-11 Green
antifreeze-g11-green.summary: Green ethylene glycol multi-effect engine coolant (antifreeze).
antifreeze-g11-green.description: Ethylene glycol (EG) based. IAT / HOAT corrosion inhibitor technology. Standard bright green, clear and transparent, with no suspended solids or stratification. Suitable for cooling systems of older cast-iron engine cars, light trucks, construction machinery, agricultural machinery, 2-stroke / 4-stroke motor boats and generator sets. Packaging: 1kg / 4kg / 5kg / 9kg / 10kg / 20kg / 200kg.

antifreeze-g11-red.name: Antifreeze G-11 Red
antifreeze-g11-red.summary: Red ethylene glycol multi-effect engine coolant (antifreeze).
antifreeze-g11-red.description: Red G-11 coolant for freeze protection, boil-over protection and metal protection in engine cooling systems. Packaging options match the green grade and can be confirmed by order.
